steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona! Sona, where are you?!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...You're being a little loud, Ashlock.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sorry, Justyna, I didn't see you there.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Wait, what are you doing in front of Sona's room? Are you looking for her too?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Where is she?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Don't know.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...Whatever, I'll spare her for now.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I know you only just joined us. It's normal to have questions.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You can ask me. I might be able to help.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...No, it isn't about the Knightclub.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I wanted to tell Sona I'll help out at her bar after all.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Oh, I see then. True, I can't help with that.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Hold on!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What did you just say? Bar? Sona?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Mm. Didn't you know?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I... Was I meant to know?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: So what did you need her for?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I need her so I can tear her head off.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: But change of plans. I'm going to figure out just when the hell she opened a bar behind my back, and then she dies.

spans.text: But change of plans. I'm going to figure out just when the hell she opened a bar behind my back, and

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: So can you tell me why she has a bar, and also, how you know about it?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...Okay.
I'm still new to the Knightclub. There's a lot I don't know about it.
Last night, Sona sent me a message, inviting me to meet her at a bar.
I thought she wanted to talk about Knightclub stuff, but I was wrong.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: So. You've come.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...Why are you... standing behind the counter?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Because I am now the stand-in owner of this private bar.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Haven't gotten a chance to tell Ashley and the rest about it yet. You're the first to know.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: At first, I was just coming here to relax from time to time.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: After a while, I got pretty chummy with the old boss of the place.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: And then I found out he used to be a director at the G.C.C., before he got targeted for offending some Knightclub.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: He couldn't take that. Quit his job in anger, opened up this little place.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I helped unhassle a few hassles for him. He's recently rediscovered his passion for his old work, and now he's gone back to where he says he belongs.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: So, he handed the bar over for me to manage.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...I feel like, you just described a dramatic story very undramatically.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You wanna hear it? I can tell you over a drink.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I thought—you invited me here... to orient me into the Knightclub.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: All I can tell you is the booze rack here's pretty darn good.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: So you asked me out for drinks?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Unfortunately! I asked you out so you could watch the bar for me. I've got stuff to handle later tonight.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We can all come here for drinks next time.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Why me?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Cause... you don't have to do much of anything here, really. You just pour your patrons a drink, listen to their stories, and tell 'em what they need to hear every now and then.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: And my gut says you're the best listener out of all of us.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: So how about it?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...I can try.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Okay, come over here, I'll teach you some bartending fundamentals...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: After she left, a steady stream of Infected arrived. She must have made sure people in the club knew about it.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: By chatting with them, I more or less got a handle on the Knightclub's present situation.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Whether it was on purpose or not, I'm glad she gave me that opportunity.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Your turn, Ashlock.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: What has she done to make you want to kill her?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: She—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hey, what're you two doing here too? Where's Sona?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Wish I knew.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Oh. Well, sure, I'll wait too then.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...What have you got there, Iwona?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Oh, this? Camcorder. Sona lent it to me.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: A camcorder? Tch, I knew it, that scoundrel...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What are you doing with it, though?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Uh, nothing big.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Sona spent all last night teaching me how to shoot with it. I'm just here to give it back.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Ohh. I see...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Excuse me? Last night?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Yeah, last night.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What the hell was she doing at your place last night?!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: She was there 'cause she was there. Is that weird?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: She was with US last night!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: And since when did the almighty Wild Mane Knight want to learn photography? For that matter, when did SONA learn it? EVERYTHING about this is weird!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Ashlock, I think it's just as weird that you came here wanting to kill her...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I... I—*sigh* I'll explain that in a bit.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: First, Iwona, tell me what happened last night.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Oh, sure.
Lately, we've been doing more and more work, taking more and more Infected in.
I'm proud of what we do, but that doesn't solve our need for more funds to settle all our Infected down somewhere.
And competition winnings are our most direct source of income, so for the last while, I've been trying to win more matches, get more of that cash.
But—patience ain't my strong suit.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Sona, I'm here.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Cool.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Funding-wise, we're gonna have issues caring for our club's Infected, I know it.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Now, I bet you called me here to chat about my recent win-loss.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I know, I haven't been putting up good results lately, but I—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Iwona, don't stretch yourself thin.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But—I wanna put in the work for our club!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Catch.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: What the... A camcorder?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Sure is.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I made a friend lately, an elderly guy. He taught me some photography tricks, and tipped me off about a certain contact who'll let us make cash for shooting.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Contact's anonymous, only cares about the end product, so the work's open to Infected too.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: So you're telling me, it's time I tried a side job?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Exactly. You're not alone—everyone goes through rough spots from time to time. Couldn't hurt to shake things up.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But... I don't know a damn thing about using a camera, though?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: That's fine, I didn't either at first. Turns out it's not all that complicated.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: First off, look here. This is the shutter, this is the lens, this is your screen.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You focus the lens on what you wanna shoot, press the shutter, and whatever you're shooting gets recorded in here...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: H-Huh, alright...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Real simple, ain't it? There's a lotta skill to camerawork—I only started picking it up myself recently.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: First, what we wanna do is learn how lighting affects a photo...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Um, uh, mrm...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...And then Sona spent a solid hour walking me through it.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Can you use it now?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I... gave up in the end.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Well, it's only your first time...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: No, Justyna, you don't understand.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Imagine Sona's telling you about lighting and composition and focal length and all this stuff like it's obvious, but you don't get it, but she doesn't get that you don't get it—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: And you're like, I'm screwed.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Sona was trying her damndest to teach me. I know, I know she means well for me.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But I seriously can't do it.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I can—not—UNDERSTAND THIS STUFF!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Maybe... you could try learning something else?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: No, Sona didn't teach me for nothing.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I'm gonna remember last night's photography lesson forever. From now on, every time I step into the arena, I'm gonna use what I went through to motivate me—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: If I don't clinch a victory in there, I'm gonna have to learn photography with Sona.'

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You could tell me to go and mend things with my family right now and it still wouldn't be as cruel as that. This way, I'm determined to win.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...That's one way to make use of it, I suppose.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Ashlock, why did you suddenly go... silent?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ... (Muttering) Photography. So that's what it was about.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Ashlock?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You were curious why I wanted to kill Sona, right?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I'm... not that curious anymore, actually.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: No, this concerns both of your futures, so I'm obligated to tell you.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: It's that serious?!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...No, I think things are getting less and less serious.
Sometimes, I feel like, even though we've been fighting together for so long, I still don't understand what goes on in her head.
Sometimes it's like nothing's happening in there at all, but other times, it's like she's thinking thirty steps ahead.
And what pisses me off is, she never tells me how she arrives at any of her ideas.
She didn't tell me this time either.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ashley, aren't you supposed to be up in the arena right now?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Look at the message you sent!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: 'Don't worry about the match, Ashley. I'll be behind the scenes pulling out all the stops for you.'

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Yeah, I told you not to worry about it, right?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Who reads a message like this and thinks 'okay then, I won't worry'?!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Jeez, Ashley, you just love stressing out for other people.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: So, just what are you doing here?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ever since the Radiant Knight came back, certain people have been pretty restless.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Certain people?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I dunno who exactly, I just know they definitely don't want what's best for the Infected, and the Radiant Knight's putting them in crisis mode.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Otherwise, they wouldn't have gone for the ancient old tactic of a PR video swaparoo.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You don't mean...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Yup. Yours, Ashley.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Look, they still haven't given up.

steps.name: A Bought-Out Knight
steps.text: How did you find this place?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: If I said... a friend told me, wouldja believe me?

steps.name: A Bought-Out Knight
steps.text: Hmph. Who'd make friends with an Infected?

steps.name: A Bought-Out Knight
steps.text: Either way, now that you know we're here, we'll just have to dispatch the two of you!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ashley, ready to warm up for a match?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...Way ahead of you.

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Where's Ashlock Knight?! She's the one I came to see!

steps.name: An Angry Spectator
steps.text: Yeah! Ashlock Knight's the whole reason anyone came here! I want a refund!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (Whispers) You still haven't found her?!

steps.name: Staffer
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (Whispers) What do we do, then?! She was top billing tonight!

steps.name: Staffer
steps.text: I don't know either! ...Shit, wait, I just got word from the director.

steps.name: Staffer
steps.text: He says, roll Ashlock Knight's PR reel first, because she'll be out any moment.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (Whispers) ...You for real?

steps.name: Staffer
steps.text: Director says he'll shoulder the blame.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (Whispers) Then we'll do it.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Now I know you're all hungry to see Ashlock Knight burst onto the scene, but hold your beasties—Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub has just let us in on her brand new PR reel.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: So why don't we get the refreshments out and watch!
Ashley, how come you never like to talk to the press at our conferences?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: That's not what it means to be a knight.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: My one duty in the arena is to defeat the enemy.
Aw, you know if you talked a little more, your fans would love it.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I don't take to the field in order to please them.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Also, stop filming me.
Oh yeah, I put all the letters from your fans in the storeroom for you.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: *sigh*... Thank you.
Sure, Ashley tells us she's under no obligation to serve the fans, but what's the truth? Let's take a look and find out.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Thank you for your letter, and I appreciate your support.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I sincerely wish you and your lover a happy life together. When you decide a date for the wedding, please let me know, and I will send a card to congratulate you.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Signed, Ashlock Knight—Greynuty.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...That should be sufficient.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Now for the next letter.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...*sigh* How come I have so many letters? I hope I can reply to all of these before dinner.
Would you look at our Ashlock Knight—it turns out she really cherishes everyone who cherishes her.
Sure, she's a little clumsy with her words, but she makes up for it by letting her every action speak for itself.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What's that sound?
Oh, she's about to notice me. Time to go.

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Ashlock Knight's such a hero on the field, though! Is she really THAT cute in private?!

steps.name: A Now-Gleeful Spectator
steps.text: I had no idea she had this side to her, yet I called myself her fan! I-I-I—I'm gonna go buy all her merch right now!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Phew—how's that? Turned out pretty good, right?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona! Wh-What the hell did you just broadcast?!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Well, a cute slice of your life, right?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Relax, I edited it myself. Everything sensitive got scrubbed out.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Isn't that meant to be a promotional video for our Knightclub?!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Yeah, so I've been thinking about that this whole time.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Our club's not gonna beat any of the corp-backed Knightclubs when it comes to cash or clout.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We'll never be a match for them if we go up against them using common sense. We need a wildcard.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: WHAT KIND OF WILDCARD WAS THAT?!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Think about it, Ashley. The way other Knightclubs promote their knights, it's so showy, so superficial.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But I think, what really endears people to someone is those cute, awkward moments no one else knows about.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: And that's where our Knightclub has the others beat!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We're always working alongside each other, so we know each other's charm points down to a T!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You just relax. I'm willing to bet you everyone will love these promos.

spans.text: You just relax. I'm willing to bet you

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I mean, the whole time I was editing them, I couldn't help thinking how cute they were!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...You're not telling me, you edited EVEN MORE of those?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Yeah. Yours, Iwona's, and a couple other members'.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I was considering doing one for our new recruit Justyna too, but I didn't have much inspiration for her at the time, so for now we just gotta get to know each other better.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: YOU—

steps.name: Staffer
steps.text: Ashlock Knight, what are you doing here?! We've been looking for you forever!

steps.name: Staffer
steps.text: Huh? What's Flametail Knight doing here t... yeek! What happened to all those people?!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You go tell the director he's got a little trash to sweep up here. I figure the garbage truck'll be passing by soon.

steps.name: Staffer
steps.text: Er, okay. Anyway, Ashlock Knight, come with me quick, your match is underway!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You wait here, Sona.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I'm heading into the arena to dispatch my opponent, and then I'm coming back to dispatch you.

spans.text: I'm heading into the arena to dispatch my opponent, and then I'm coming back to dispatch

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Do you see now? That's why I'm here to end her life.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: More and more, I feel like joining Pinus Sylvestris was the right decision.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...And what exactly in our conversation could've led you to THAT conclusion?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Lots.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: If my guess is correct, the bar owner Sona took over for is the one who taught her photography.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: And at the same time, he's the 'friend' she said told her about the PR problem—the director for your match.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...I'm sorry?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: In that bar, she met the ex-director turned bar owner, made friends with him, then learned some photography from him later.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Not only that, she cleared up the haze hanging over him, and made him willing to hand management of the bar over to her and return to his own work.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Finally, he noticed something was wrong with your promo, and notified Sona straight away.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: That's my understanding.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: For serious?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: All I got out of it was that last night, she taught Justyna how to run a bar, then sprinted over to my place to teach me how to work the camera, then went and solved the thing with Greynuty's PR vid for her.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I knew she was fast, but that's screwy fast!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Seen another way, it shows that she never lets the problems each member of her Knightclub faces escape her.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You're right. Incredible, she is, that Sona.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Wait, wait, why do you two admire her MORE now?!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Because seeing the reality, I have to admit... she's a leader far beyond what I imagined.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Maybe she's just lucky, you don't know.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Then I have a question.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I once had the idea of establishing a Knightclub, and looked into it. So I know—

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It'd be almost impossible for an Infected to form a Knightclub focused on Infected.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: So in the course of founding Pinus Sylvestris, did you ever run into any difficulties?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Now you mention it, after Sona said she was going to found a Knightclub, there was a little while before she brought me straight here.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: And told me that as of today, this would be Pinus Sylvestris's base.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...That settles it then. Every last thing I thought impossibly hard to deal with, she dealt with.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: How hard?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Harder than you actually getting to tear off her head today, perhaps.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...Tch.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: She's always like this, never telling me a damn thing.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I haven't known her for long, but I've never once seen her just say what's on her mind like that.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Ashlock, you're her closest companion. If she were ever in a difficult place, I don't think she'd keep it from you.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What are you trying to tell me?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: That maybe, you've gotten it into your head... that she won't share her burdens with you.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: But maybe... the reason she never tells you is just because... none of it registers as difficult for her.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: From her perspective, she's not hiding problems she doesn't want to drag you into, she's just...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Dealing with things naturally as they come, and there's never much about them she needs to share.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: That... does seem like the way she'd do things.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Wild Mane just said Sona did three things yesterday.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: But maybe, it's just that we only know of three things.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Who knows. Maybe there were five, ten, or even more.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: To Sona, the photography Iwona found so hard might've just been one of the many skills in her pocket.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Maybe, a day in her life is more full than any of us can imagine.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Man, that was fun stuff. I've gotta find someone to spar with me, ASAP.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona?!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Huh? Hey, the whole gang's here.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Morning, Ashley, everyone.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Morn... wait, why did you come out of the training grounds?

spans.text: Morn... wait, why did you come out of the

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Don't tell me you were there all night?!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Sure was.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: After I got back from the arena last night, I watched a little Left-hand Knight footage, did a little solo training.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Slept right there in the training grounds.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...sakes.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You—You did all of that yesterday and STILL felt like staying behind and training?!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: By all of that, you mean... all of what exactly?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Taking Justyna to the bar, teaching Iwona photography, sorting out my PR reel? Was that not enough for you?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ahh—that's just 'cause everything just happened to line up in the evening.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Whassup, Ashley?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You look like you're gonna fall apart there. What's wrong? Talk to me. Who knows, I might be able to help?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You're the cause, okay...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Me...? Something wrong with me?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Look, putting that aside, studying those Left-hand Knight tapes gave me a pretty fun idea I'm sitting on right now.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: C'mon, let's go test it out.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Tch. I've decided.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You filmed me in secret, so now I'm going to film you back.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Sure! I was just thinking I had no one to shoot my own promo.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: All day today, I'm going to follow you. Wherever you go, I'll go with you.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I'm going to see just how much you can do in a single day!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Haha, that's a lotta pep in your step for you, Ashley! Heck yeah!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: And we'll start with me laying you flat on the ground!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Let's roll!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...Hey, wait up, Sona, take your camcorder back first!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...The Infected have no place to go.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: But together with these people, with Flametail Knight Sona... perhaps, Justyna the Infected can go anywhere.
